name: WH40K DOW DE - Traditional Chinese Locale Font Fix
author: Community Contributor
description: Fixes text clipping and scaling issues in the Traditional Chinese locale for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition. Includes anti-clipping fallback profile and optional Microsoft YaHei font replacement.

instructions.install: Extract to your DoW:DE installation folder. Then run setup_relic_tool.ps1 to install dependencies.
instructions.setup:
1. Run setup_relic_tool.ps1
2. Run unpack_chinese_locale.ps1
3. Run apply_font_fix.py with desired options
4. Remove or rename original EnginLoc.sga if using unpacked mode
instructions.usage: See README.md for detailed usage instructions and font size tuning options.

scripts.name: setup_relic_tool.ps1
scripts.description: Install SGA tools and Python dependencies (run once)

scripts.name: repack_chinese_locale.ps1
scripts.description: Repack modified data/ into new .sga archive
